review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/icse-g05.json. 10 of 10 chapter titles could not be checked against an official source (marked sourceVerified: false). Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://cdn1.byjus.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/ICSEClass-5-Maths-Syllabus.pdf https://cisce.org/ https://byjus.com/icse-class-5-maths-syllabus/. Notes: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE: the official CISCE document could not be opened (cisce.org was unreachable from the build environment). The themes and outcomes come from a third-party copy of the Class V mathematics pages, read through a text summary, so every theme is verified:false. CISCE is understood not to prescribe a textbook for Class V (not checked against an official statement): each school chooses its own books and may order or extend the topics differently. Check this inventory against the school's actual textbook and term plan. The document lists 78 learning-outcome lines in ten themes. They are written here as 75 outcomes in OpenPath's own words (lines that repeat a skill are merged, and the line on pie charts and line graphs is split in two), plus 2 items that appear only under key concepts (tables to 20; dividing fractions): 77 in all. 70 are mapped (56 fully, 14 partly: see each outcome's coverage and note). 7 are not in the release and are listed under gaps: 3 have no OpenPath skill, and 4 (number line, and the meaning, comparing and ordering of integers) have questions but a lesson that fails OpenPath's teaching checks.
